items.title: 66600_Teddy Wilson oral history interview
items.q: Here John Hammond gets on the phone, and breaks the color line in studio musicians -- Specs Powell, and I think you were there, and Cozy Cole, right.

ctx.x: Yeah, he was tremendous; he did so much for that.

See, he could do that -- he had enough power and know how. He was a very smart man, you know, and jumping forward a little bit, when the color line was broken with the staff radio musicians, you know, John Hammond called on the phone the President of the corporation and said to mix up the band and that he wanted a mixed band in the studio, so they did it. And the NAACP was having rallies in Madison Square Garden and marching up and down the street, and nothing was happening. Here John Hammond gets on the phone,…
